ingredients: 1 cup or more cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain and season with salt and pepper.
Cook noodles according to package directions.
In a casserole dish, layer half the meat, then the sauerkraut, then remaining meat.
Add noodles over the top and cover with both soups.
Cover and bake at 300°F for 30 minutes.
Remove cover, top with shredded cheese, and bake an additional 20 minutes.
